intent: Read source and produce evidence or recommendations; no repository writes, deployments, remote comments, or credential changes.

tools.name: YorpHives read-only reviewer
tools.role: Checks static source, links, catalog, JavaScript syntax, and limited security signals; watches a local directory or public Git branch.
tools.license: Project source; no separate license specified.
tools.external_network: Only public Git fetch if the operator starts Git-watch.
tools.outputs: Private local reports outside the source tree.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.external_network: None required for local tests; block unintended outbound requests.
tools.notes: Test code runs the site and must be isolated; no browser bot is configured yet.

tools.name: Reviewdog
tools.role: Aggregate and filter output from other analyzers against changed code.
tools.notes: Use local reporter; GitHub comments and checks require extra write permissions and are not enabled.

tools.name: Betterleaks
tools.role: Detect exposed credentials in files and Git history.
tools.notes: Pin and verify a stable version; use redacted output, disable credential validation and analysis, and do not run revoke.

tools.name: Trivy
tools.role: Inspect dependency vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and licenses.
tools.notes: Scanning needs locally available and refreshed vulnerability databases; database updates are a separate network operation.

tools.name: PR-Agent
tools.notes: Use a local model and local Git provider with output outside the project. Disable publishing and any write or auto-improve actions; model and policy enforcement are not configured.
